criteria_results.title: Change control notice period deviation identified (30 days vs. 90 days mandatory)

criteria_results.title: Change control fallback notice period referenced (60 calendar days)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue #8 and the §8.2 table cite the 60-calendar-day fallback, which needs a VP QA written exception.

criteria_results.title: Change control approval mechanism deviation identified (commercially reasonable efforts vs. prior written approval)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue #8 flags the 'commercially reasonable efforts to accommodate comments' notify-and-comment model and recommends Ceritas prior written approval.

criteria_results.title: Critical deviation notification window deviation identified (72 hours vs. 24 hours)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue #11 flags 72 hours from classification against the Mandatory 24 hours from detection.

criteria_results.title: Major deviation reporting deviation identified (monthly summary vs. 5 business days)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue #12 flags that Major deviations go only into the monthly summary, while the Playbook requires 5 business days.

criteria_results.title: Absence of root-cause analysis timelines in draft flagged

criteria_results.title: Playbook RCA deadline for critical deviations cited (15 business days)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue #13 cites the Playbook §5.2 requirement of 15 business days for Critical deviations.

criteria_results.title: Playbook RCA deadline for major deviations cited (30 business days)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue #13 cites the Playbook requirement of 30 business days for Major deviations.

criteria_results.title: CAPA approval authority deviation identified (Pinnacle retains authority vs. Ceritas sole authority for critical deviations)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue #14 flags Pinnacle's sole CAPA approval authority, with Ceritas limited to 'input', against Ceritas approval as a condition precedent for Critical CAPAs.

criteria_results.title: Batch disposition authority market-split deviation identified
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue #16 flags EU final disposition with Pinnacle's QP and US disposition with Ceritas, against Ceritas final disposition for all markets.

criteria_results.title: Raw data turnaround deviation identified (10 vs. 2 business days)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue #19 flags 10 business days 'upon reasonable request' against the Playbook's 2 business days.

criteria_results.title: APQR submission deadline deviation identified (90 vs. 60 calendar days)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue #21 flags the 90-day APQR deadline against the Mandatory 60 days.

criteria_results.title: Audit frequency cap deviation identified (one per year vs. unlimited)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue #23 flags the cap of one routine audit per year against the Mandatory unlimited frequency.

criteria_results.title: Audit notice period deviation identified (20 vs. 10 business days)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue #23 flags 20 business days' notice against the Playbook's 10 business days.

criteria_results.title: For-cause audit mutual agreement restriction identified
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue #24 flags that for-cause audits need Pinnacle's agreement, a de facto veto the Playbook prohibits.

criteria_results.title: Regulatory inspection notification window deviation identified (5 business days vs. 24 hours)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue #27 flags 5-business-day inspection notice against the Mandatory 24 hours.

criteria_results.title: Missing Ceritas right to participate in or observe regulatory inspections identified

criteria_results.title: Recall decision authority deviation identified (joint vs. Ceritas sole authority)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue #30 flags joint recall decisions against Ceritas's sole recall and field-alert authority.

criteria_results.reasoning: Issue #31 flags the 50/50 split unless willful misconduct against the Playbook rule that the CDMO bears costs of its cGMP, specification or QA failures.

criteria_results.title: Subcontracting prior written consent requirement deviation identified

criteria_results.title: Missing subcontractor Ceritas audit qualification requirement identified

criteria_results.title: Data integrity provision flagged as limited to 21 CFR Part 11 only

criteria_results.title: Stability results reporting deviation identified (quarterly summaries vs. 5 business days per time-point)
